title: Loop Angles Registry (per module)
description: REQ-003 FR-005: module-level append-mostly angles registry at docs/design/angles/{module}.yaml. File name = AngleRegistryFileName(modulePath) = trim slashes + replace / with -. File body is JSON (YAML 1.2 JSON subset) to keep the harness dependency-free. The .yaml extension is preserved per REQ-003 §10 for human-reader familiarity. Append-mostly: retract appends to refactor_history, revive appends to revive_history; physical deletion is forbidden (enforced by runtime API).

module.description: Module path represented by this registry (e.g. 'internal/change'). Must be consistent with the file name (AngleRegistryFileName).

version.description: Monotonic per-module version. Bumped on every mutation (create/confirm/retract/revive).

angleID.description: Monotonic per-module id. Suffix = uppercase last path segment. Number is zero-padded min 3 digits.

statement.description: Short single-sentence description of what this angle examines.

target.description: Concrete examination object: file path, runtime invariant, or failure mode. Generic category words (security/performance/correctness/reliability/safety/usability/maintainability/testability) are blacklisted by runtime.ValidateAngleTarget.
